### 2. The correction

PATCH 7 said the merge_group and workflow_dispatch triggers "name no start at all, where every ordinal is a typed
miss and the walk is a full walk". That does not follow from the expression and is wrong on the facts: the locate
step is gated `if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'` (`.github/workflows/witnesses.yml:311`), so on a trigger
whose guard skips it the step never runs — a skipped step, not twelve typed misses — and neither walk runs to be
full or partial. An empty-expression case and a guarded-skip case were conflated.

The sentence now reads, and this is the whole change:

```
// The start comes from parse_verdict_ancestor_base_sha_expr: github.event.pull_request.base.sha when
// github.event_name is pull_request, otherwise github.event.before -- so a default-branch push starts at the
// commit main held before this event. That expression only NAMES the start; whether any of these steps runs is
// decided separately by the guards on the steps themselves, and this paragraph makes no claim about triggers
// whose guards skip them. In the emitted workflow the locate step and the reuse walk both run under
// github.event_name == 'pull_request', and the publish walk under github.event_name == 'push' &&
// github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'. The list is
```

The three guards quoted are read off the committed YAML: locate `:311`, the reuse walk `:480`
(`if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'`), the publish walk `:486`
(`if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'`). No execution is claimed for any trigger.
